game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep flint stones safe from blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep flint stones safe from blizzard sprites. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about scope_safe to power up the innkeeper and open the watch bell.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Northern Wall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
